[1/4] Plan: barrel and bomb blasts ignite nearby breakables with a short cascading fuse, primed props glow hot, and breaks shed physical debris

impact_assessment.why: Barrels explode solo and breakables vanish into additive sparks, so environmental clusters have no payoff and destruction reads as light rather than matter
impact_assessment.benefits: Chain reactions reward luring enemies into prop clusters and watching for lit fuses; debris and fuse glow make the environment legible and physical
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (Hazard gains optional ignite, no exported signature changes); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: fuse timers are transient sim state and never serialized
impact_assessment.mitigation: Player i-frames bound chain damage; ignition is capped per prop; 182 tests plus new chain tests, lint, typecheck, build and 8 gates

impact_assessment.risks: contract: AttackKind and Archetype widen, FloorPlan count 16 -> 17 shifts late depths; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: saves keyed by depth shift by one for sections after 15
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the mirror trial boss-only at depth 15, push keeper to 16, update content tests and ADR, run 8 gates and headless pixel probes
